verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's public GitHub repository describes the product as "Open Source", and the official docs call it "the open-source platform". Independent community comments confirm it is open source with an optional cloud SaaS. A hands-on probe booted the official image with no license, which supports open availability. Missing for 10: the specific license name and terms (e.g. MIT vs. source-available) are not stated in the evidence, and it is not documented whether any premium features sit under a separate commercial license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Open Source Feature Flags, Experimentation, and Product Analytics
